### Refinement support and entry measurements

The support statements on this page come from unmodified prepared packages.
Those packages contain the generated checks that enforce `Fin`, `Subtype` and
checked-record contracts, but they do not contain diagnostic entry counters.

Entry measurements use separate instrumented fixture packages. They count the
named validator, constructor, adapter and Lean-source entries for 28
ordinary/reviewed routes in 26 retained artifacts. The counters do not change a
consumer package or widen its supported types. The [promotion
workflow](https://github.com/seanmorris/lean-bridge/actions/workflows/php-wasm-refinement-entry-promotion.yml)
is configured to rebuild the complete matrix at one revision and recheck the
retained artifacts. Until a completed run publishes that verified summary, the
documentation makes no hosted entry-count claim.

Source-dispatch counters were not measured in these unmodified package runs.

## Refinement checks and measurement probes

Unmodified prepared PHP-Wasm packages enforce supported `Fin`, `Subtype` and
checked-record contracts with their ordinary generated adapters. They do not
ship validator, constructor, adapter or Lean-source entry counters.

Lean Bridge measures those entries in separate instrumented fixture packages.
The closed matrix has 28 ordinary/reviewed routes in 26 retained artifacts; it
does not widen the prepared-package type surface or become part of a consumer
release. The [promotion
workflow](https://github.com/seanmorris/lean-bridge/actions/workflows/php-wasm-refinement-entry-promotion.yml)
is configured to rebuild all four producer groups at one revision and verify
their retained bytes. Do not describe its counts as hosted evidence until a
completed promotion run publishes the verified summary.

PHP-Wasm refinement support is established by unmodified prepared packages.
The separate entry-measurement probes instrument fixture packages only: their
closed topology has 28 ordinary/reviewed routes in 26 retained artifacts and
does not widen any type-support cell. The configured [promotion
workflow](https://github.com/seanmorris/lean-bridge/actions/workflows/php-wasm-refinement-entry-promotion.yml)
is not a hosted result; entry counts become hosted evidence only when a
completed run publishes a verified summary for one revision.
